headline: Public hearings on parking reduction at 956 Dwight Street, and zone changes at 120 & 0 Pine Street and 12 Crescent Street.
summary: Three public hearings are on the agenda, covering a parking special permit and two zone changes. Other business includes the Comprehensive Plan Update, an ISO file update, and a tentative meeting schedule.
